hv2_meta_title: Mochifile — file tools in plain words
hv2_meta_description: Compress images to the size you need, free and private, right in your browser. Say what you need in plain words; browser tools keep your files on your device.
hv2_hero_eyebrow: File tools that run in your browser
hv2_hero_title_start: Compress images, video and PDFs in
hv2_hero_lead: Drop a file and say what you need: “under 50 KB”, “square for eBay”, “WebP for my site”. Mochifile works out the format, size and settings. Browser tools run on your device, so your files stay with you.
hv2_install_copy_hint: Available when the CLI is published
hv2_cli_note: Planned commands for Windows, macOS and Linux. The CLI hasn’t been published yet.
hv2_prompt_placeholder: Under 50 KB for a job form, square crop, WebP for my site…
hv2_check_plain: Plain-English requests, no settings to learn
hv2_check_one_drop: Images, video and PDFs in one drop zone
hv2_check_batch: Batch up to 20 files, zipped on the way out
hv2_check_free: Free, no account and no monthly limit
hv2_hub_lead: One engine, six ways in. Pick the one that fits how you work.
hv2_hub_alt: One engine, six surfaces: CLI, local MCP, Chrome extension, web app, hosted MCP and REST API
hv2_surface_local_mcp_text: Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor and any stdio MCP client. Your agent passes file paths, not image data, so files stay on disk.
hv2_surface_cli_text: Scripts, CI and agent pipelines. One small binary that reads from and writes to pipes.
hv2_surface_chrome_text: Right-click any image on the web: convert it in one click, or describe the change you want.
hv2_surface_web_text: Drop, type, done. Nothing to install, and the browser tools run on your own device.
hv2_surface_hosted_text: A connector that lives inside your AI chat. Sign in once and ask it to crop, convert or shrink.
hv2_surface_api_text: Bearer-token auth. Call it from cURL, JavaScript, Python or anything that speaks HTTPS.
hv2_ask_title: Compression is just one thing you can ask for
hv2_ask_lead: Type it the way you would say it. Mochifile works out the formats, sizes and settings. Tap an example to try it.
hv2_ask_images_1: Under 50 KB for a job form
hv2_ask_video_1: Convert to WebM for the web
hv2_ask_video_2: Keep only the audio as MP3
hv2_ask_note: Compressing an image works today, free. The other examples are coming soon.
hv2_privacy_text: Browser tools open, change and save your files inside your own browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, so there is nothing for us to keep, leak or delete. Results are re-encoded from the pixels, so hidden details such as location and camera model are removed.
hv2_faq_1_a: Yes. The browser tools are free to use, with no account and no monthly limit: you can process up to 20 files at a time, 50 MB each. Paid plans are planned, but not available yet.
hv2_faq_2_a: No. Browser tools open, change and save your files inside your own browser tab, so nothing is sent to a server. Features that would need a server are labelled, and none is live yet.
hv2_faq_3_q: Do I need to install anything?
hv2_faq_3_a: No. Open the page and drop your files. A command-line tool, MCP servers and a Chrome extension are planned for people who want them, and are marked Coming soon.
hv2_faq_4_a: Today the compressor takes JPG, PNG and WebP images, up to 20 files at a time and 50 MB each. HEIC isn’t supported yet. Video, audio and PDF tools are coming.
hv2_faq_5_q: Can I use it on my phone?
hv2_faq_5_a: Yes. The site works on phones and tablets, and the browser tools run on the device itself, so very large files may take longer on an older phone.
hv2_faq_6_a: Yes. The code is public on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 licence, so anyone can check how it works.
hv2_cta_lead: Pick a tool or just describe what you need. Your files stay on your device.
hv2_soon_text: We are still building this part of Mochifile. Today you can compress an image to the size you need, free and in your browser.
